notes: Crystal and Spark are starter cards; all other entries are supply candidates.

cards.name: Crystal
cards.effect: Gain 1 Aether.

cards.name: Burning Opal
cards.effect: Gain 3 Aether. You may discard a card in hand. If you do, any ally draws a card.

cards.name: Clouded Sapphire
cards.effect: Gain 3 Aether. If this is the first time you have played Clouded Sapphire this turn, any ally gains 1 charge.

cards.name: Diamond Cluster
cards.effect: Gain 2 Aether. If this is the second time you have played Diamond Cluster this turn, gain an additional 2 Aether.

cards.name: Jade
cards.effect: Gain 2 Aether.

cards.name: Searing Ruby
cards.effect: Gain 2 Aether. Gain an additional 1 Aether that can only be used to gain a spell.

cards.name: Sifter's Pearl
cards.effect: Gain 2 Aether. Each player reveals the top card of their deck and either discards it or returns it to the top of their deck.

cards.name: V'riswood Amber
cards.effect: When you gain this, you may place it on top of your deck. Gain 2 Aether.

cards.name: Blasting Staff
cards.effect: You may cast a prepped spell that you prepped this turn. If you do, that spell deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Bottled Vortex
cards.effect: Destroy this. Destroy up to two cards in your hand or discard pile. Draw a card.

cards.name: Flexing Dagger
cards.effect: The next time you focus or open a breach this turn, it costs 3 Aether less. OR Destroy this. Deal 1 damage.

cards.name: Focusing Orb
cards.effect: Focus any player's breach. OR Destroy this. Gravehold gains 3 life.

cards.name: Mage's Talisman
cards.effect: Gain 1 charge. Any ally gains 1 charge.

cards.name: Unstable Prism
cards.effect: Play a gem in hand twice and destroy it. OR Gain 2 Aether.

cards.name: Amplify Vision
cards.effect: Cast: Focus your closed breach with the lowest focus cost. Deal 2 damage. If all of your breaches are opened, deal 1 additional damage.

cards.name: Arcane Nexus
cards.effect: While prepped, once per turn during your main phase you may return a gem you played this turn to your hand. Cast: Deal 4 damage.

cards.name: Chaos Arc
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 3 damage. Deal 2 additional damage for each prepped spell in an adjacent breach.

cards.name: Consuming Void
cards.effect: Cast: Destroy up to two cards in hand. Deal 3 damage for each card destroyed in this way.

cards.name: Dark Fire
cards.effect: Cast: Discard up to two cards in hand. Deal 3 damage for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Essence Theft
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 3 damage. You may discard a card in hand. If you do, any player gains 1 life.

cards.name: Feral Lightning
cards.effect: This spell may be prepped to a closed breach without focusing it. Cast: Deal 3 damage.

cards.name: Ignite
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 2 damage. Any ally gains 1 charge.

cards.name: Lava Tendril
cards.effect: While prepped, at the end of your casting phase deal 1 damage. Cast: Deal 3 damage.

cards.name: Oblivion Swell
cards.effect: While prepped, once per turn during your main phase you may gain 1 Aether. Cast: Deal 2 damage. You may discard a gem. If you do, deal additional damage equal to its cost.

cards.name: Phoenix Flame
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 2 damage. You may lose 1 charge to deal 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Planar Insight
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 2 damage. Deal 1 additional damage for each of your opened breaches.

cards.name: Spark
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 1 damage.

cards.name: Spectral Echo
cards.effect: Cast: Deal 2 damage. You may destroy a card in hand.

cards.name: Wildfire Whip
cards.effect: While prepped, during your main phase you may spend 2 Aether to cast any player's prepped spell. Cast: Deal 4 damage.
